FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_COUNTER.title: Counter
FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_COUNTER.description: When you are attacked, this card may be played automatically as a counter-attack.
FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_PAIN.title: Pain
FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_PAIN.description: Whenever you play a card while this is in your hand, lose 1 HP.
FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_SUPPORT.title: Support
FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_SUPPORT.description: This card summons an ally to perform its effect. Support cards are generated by certain effects and are not part of your starting deck.
FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_EPHEMERAL.title: Ephemeral
FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_EPHEMERAL.description: After this card is played, it is removed from your deck for the rest of the run.
FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_FOOTWORK.title: Footwork
FLAMETAIL_KEYWORD_FOOTWORK.description: Every 5 Footwork turns into 1 Dodge. At the start of your turn, lose 1 Footwork.
